overview.description: The Invesco RAFI US 1000 ETF (PRF) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the RAFI Fundamental Select US 1500 index. The fund tracks an index of 1,000 of the largest US companies that are selected and weighted using fundamental metrics. PRF was launched on Dec 19, 2005 and is issued by Invesco.
